topography.project_purpose: Onchain Capital Allocator. Structurally: 82 project-authored contract(s) across 10 chain(s); 3 ERC4626 vaults, 12 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 10 functional families. Its contracts share 11 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, erc1967upgrade, withdrawalbufferstoragev1). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
